ns2:section.sectionText: Major restrictions will be removed on November 28, 2018. Contact mathadvising@illinois.edu if you have questions. Math minors may attempt to register for this class on Nov. 28, 2018; however admission to the minor does not guarantee a seat in any math course. Students completing Math 241 and hoping to transfer to the Mathematics major should make an appointment with a math advisor during early registration. Some seats are reserved for off-campus math transfer students; any remaining seats will be opened on the Friday before spring classes begin.
